description: The Desalination Pulse: High-fidelity supply dynamics and dependency dashboard.
methodology: H-Sync Dashboard Architecture: Implemented a horizontally concatenated multi-idiom dashboard. Top Layer: Synchronized area chart contrasting 'Total Urban Demand' (engineered from residential/non-residential sum) against the 'Desalination Pulse'. Bottom Layer: Derived dependency bar chart calculating the real-time ratio of seawater vs. total supply. Temporal Safeguard: Strictly capped the timeline at 2021 to ensure narrative consistency with the engineered pivot and eliminate wet-year outliers. Forensic Tooltips: Integrated detailed hover states for all supply components to allow for granular data exploration.
citation: Melbourne Water. (2026). Greater Melbourne Potable Demand & Desalination Orders. Spatially and temporally harmonized by D. Sharma (2026).
